body:
commit abd4a74. The kanban board's drag-and-drop previously only moved cards between columns -- dropping a card back within its own column was a silent no-op with no position write-back, even though the backend already supported PATCH .../cards/{id} {"position":N}, just unused by the frontend. New: (1) live drag reorder -- onCardDragOver moves the dragged DOM node into place as the cursor crosses a sibling card's top/bottom half; onDrop reads the final real DOM order for that column and PATCHes every card in it with a fresh, gapless 0..n-1 position (handles a cross-column drop in the same pass). (2) click-based up/down buttons (moveCardBy) using a server-confirmed order cache (kanbanOrder), a reliable non-drag alternative for inputs where drag isn't practical to use or test. New TestKanban_PatchPositionReordersColumn -- a real integration test proving the underlying position-PATCH contract end to end (3 cards created, PATCHed into reverse order, GET reflects the new order). go build/vet/test ./... clean, zero regressions across the whole repo. Live-verified: iduna.service rebuilt and restarted, /health green, /admin/kanban correctly still gated (401 unauthenticated) -- the admin auth boundary this change sits behind was untouched.

⚓ ☃
title: S207-68: real kanban within-column card sorting (drag reorder + up/down buttons)
